The lines had fallen unto Judah in pleasant places, and the bounds of that habitation were no work of chance, but of Him who divided to the nations their inheritance (Deu 32:8). Ziph stands as a witness that no portion of the land, and no day of the saint’s affliction, lies outside the keeping of God.

He makes the wilderness a pool of water and the dry ground springs; and the saint who finds his portion bare may trust that the God who set Maarath in the inheritance has not forgotten to bless even the barren places of his life.
